height_cascade.note: Commencement Certificate EB/4172/E/A/FCC/4/Amend states complete vertical stack in words (plinth, 6th podium top level, 39th floor, 50th/51st floor, up to 57th upper floors of wing/tower A & B) but gives zero per-storey elevations in metres. Elevation cascade operates at Rank 4 (assumed-floor-height).

ownership_structure.evidence: Clause 14 and definitions of Agreement for Sale mandate the formation of an Organization under the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act 1960 ('Society to be formed under the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act 1960 or such other association') by flat and shop purchasers of Tower A and Tower B.

SC1.evidence: Full vertical storey stack is comprehensively described in words across Commencement Certificate EB/4172/E/A/FCC/4/Amend and Occupancy Certificates (plinth, 6th podium top, 39th floor, 50th/51st floor, up to 57th upper floors of wing/tower A & B), but zero per-storey elevation anchors in metres are stated in the municipal CC endorsements.

SC2.evidence: Approval documents and inventory schedules identify typologies (2BHK, 3BHK, 3BHK Large, PH, and refuge variations) rather than dimensioned distinct floor plate templates by storey.
SC2.source_page: sold unsold inventory.pdf, pages 1-11; Salsette IOD.pdf, page 1

SC3.evidence: CAD floor blueprints showing dimensioned unit boundaries and closed inner wall faces are completely missing from the filing set.
SC3.source_page: Layout plan.pdf, page 1; Salsette IOD.pdf, pages 1-2

SC4.evidence: Declared carpet area is explicitly tabulated per unit with separate individual columns for CA-RERA sqm, Balcony sqm, and Terrace sqm across all 523 apartments in sold unsold inventory.pdf.

SC5.evidence: An independent second area source exists via the CA-certified Form 3 statements submitted in two distinct parts (sold unsold part1.pdf and sold unsold part 2.pdf by Omprakash Kedia & Co.), cross-verifying the developer inventory table.
SC5.source_page: sold unsold part1.pdf, pages 1-10; sold unsold part 2.pdf, pages 1-4

SC6.evidence: Property is tied to Cadastral Survey No. 707 of Mazgaon Division, E Ward, with verified geographic centroid (18.9725° N, 72.8355° E), although the submitted layout plan document is present only as a photograph of a computer monitor.
SC6.source_page: Agreement for Sale Shop.pdf, page 30; Layout plan.pdf, page 1

SC7.evidence: Ownership framework is established as a Co-operative Housing Society under the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act 1960 as stipulated in Clause 14 and definitions of the Agreement for Sale.

SC8.evidence: Non-saleable and common spaces are designated explicitly: refuge units are specifically itemized in the inventory typology column (e.g. 2BHK-04-Refuge), Public Parking Lot (PPL) is detailed across 3 basements and ground floor, and a podium-top temple structure is sanctioned.
SC8.source_page: sold unsold inventory.pdf, pages 2, 6; part-1 occupation.pdf, page 1; Full oc salsette.pdf, page 1

not_found.consequence: Commencement certificate provides full stack in words (plinth through 57th floor) but gives zero per-storey elevation levels in metres; cascade drops to rank 4 (assumed-floor-height).
No unit-level internal dimensioned drawings with bounding wall faces; layout is present only as a photo of a computer monitor, preventing automated tier D-SURVEYED geometric reconstruction.

anomalies.description: Layout Drawing Present Only as a Photograph of a Computer Monitor: Layout plan.pdf consists solely of an unscaled phone snapshot of an AutoCAD viewport on an LCD monitor, exhibiting moire patterns and lacking dimensioned vectors.
anomalies.significance: Represents a 'present but not usable' statutory filing requiring manual digitization or external cadastral cross-referencing.

anomalies.description: Issuing Authority Questioned Authenticity of Its Own Occupancy Certificate: Official correspondence from the BMC Deputy Chief Engineer (Building Proposals City) was required to verify and confirm to MahaRERA that the Full OC letter EB/4172/E/A had indeed been legitimately issued.
documents_involved: BMC-BP City email about OC authenticity.pdf
anomalies.significance: Demonstrates an administrative self-verification anomaly where statutory register integrity required inter-agency email verification.

anomalies.description: Out-of-Sequence Podium Occupancy: Part OCC EB/4172/E/A/OCC/1/New dated 16-Dec-2022 granted occupation for '1st Podium + 3rd to 6th Podium', with the 2nd Podium omitted from the initial occupancy approval and completed subsequently.
anomalies.significance: Reflects out-of-sequence physical completion and phased statutory handovers within a single podium envelope.

something_new.description: Detailed Dual-Tower Unit Disclosures with Balcony Separation: Complete inventory schedule of 523 apartments across Tower A and Tower B with distinct, non-zero balcony areas (ranging from 2.54 to 7.39 sq.m) and terrace areas, satisfying documentary validation criteria.

Public Parking Lot (PPL) Substructure Handover: Dedicated PPL facility across Ground and 3 basements developed and completed under separate municipal Part 1 OCC EB/4172/E/A/OCC/1/New dated 21-Sep-2021 prior to tower completion.

Podium-Top Religious Structure Sanction: Formal municipal full occupancy granted for a religious structure (Temple) situated on the top of the 6th podium floor under Full OCC EB/4172/E/A/OCC/3/New dated 31-Oct-2024.
